verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Zulip publishes an API reference at zulip.com/api, with endpoint pages such as "Send a message" generated from an OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec. Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples such as an in-browser try-it console. A static reference, or a spec a user could load into an external tool, is adjacent support and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
